name: az_10_4
description: 2026-10-04 UNGATED continuation of the az_10_2 candidate line (its slot-7 snapshot gen__azv674048, the newest gen__azv*; az_10_2 was interrupted in slot 8 and its league progress is archived in checkpoints/az/archive_az_10_2_run/). gate_every 0: no slot is gated, self-play always uses the newest candidate (no pinning, no line pruning), and the last candidate is promoted to gen__azfinal unconditionally at run completion so the closing az:gen baseline measures it. Training stays at one automatic pass per slot (~230 batches over the 50-rows-per-game pool): the 10-04 A/B/C/D test (az_pi_levers/abcd/) found 3 passes or 150 rows per game left next-slot policy KL unchanged-to-worse and next-slot value MSE worse (0.619 -> 0.630-0.644) than one pass at 50. The 16-rows-per-game value cap stays, and the per-slot FRESH / HOLDOUT lines track generalization. Policy surprise weighting share 0.5: each game's <=50 policy rows are drawn half uniformly, half in proportion to the row's grouped policy KL under the incoming net (KataGo-style), with value rows drawn uniformly and separately; policy loss and KL metrics compare duplicate-option groups. The interrupted slot-8 pass's 49 shards and slot 7's shards are the newest in az_data/gen, so the first slot's auto window (2x its new shards, newest by mtime) trains on them. Search and data settings match az_10_2: c_puct 1.5, 4 worlds with shared root noise, full_search_frac 0.5, 12 exhaustive repeats per pair + 24 rotating vs-scripted:hard cells, rows_per_game 50, lr 5e-5, expert shards off. Track progress with the anchor ladder rather than gates.
